mode: V8 con DOM minimo simulato: funzioni reali del prototipo, eventi dei controlli e SVG; nessun bootstrap HTML/CSS completo, nessun jsdom o rendering browser. Alcuni ridisegni sono sostituiti durante la navigazione.

checks.name: JavaScript parses as a standalone script
First explicit choice matches handle and opposite hinges, with an unambiguous pull-side view
Casing selection has one material-labeled detail; each side has its own position step
All 54 casing shape/side/position details have finite outlines and different wall/jamb hatching
Opening and leaf measurements show only the measured object, with exterior dimensions and a visible handle
A straight square leaf cannot create a gasket or phantom film cut, including stale profile options
Largest-face measurements preserve the physical cut plan for one and two rebates, including isolated gasket edge strips
Gasket presence questions are consecutive for the frame and both complex leaves, with details afterwards
Reference and closure previews label the real components; jamb-stop dimensions have no leaf shape
A square leaf selected as flush has zero projection and a valid nonempty cutting list
Mirroring the full section is applied exactly once and preserves a valid rebated leaf and all cutting quantities
Complete one-leaf guided sequence: left handle, flush closure, explicit dimensions and job addition
Complete unequal two-leaf sequence without header or casings: independent sizes, unique frame count and job addition
Door drawing does not fail for either face covered alone, both faces or no face
